The idea

Alchemy turned base metal into gold. We do it to people. You arrive dehydrated, jet-lagged, tired in the face. You leave looking like you had a week off. Two rooms, one promise. The drip works from the inside. The needle works from the outside. Neither one ever apologises.

The room.

Four chairs, one black door, a nurse who's seen worse than you. Headphones on, hour gone.
